description: Documents the PROPOSED combined-dataset design for Milestone 4B. This is a design/tracking artifact, not an executed merged training file. No merged dataset has been created yet -- pending review.

external_curated_v1.provenance: external_generated_unknown_source (100% of records -- no source in this file claims verified real-world provenance)
known_limitations: length confound not resolved: HIGH mean 391.6 chars vs LOW 199.7 vs CAUTION 209.7 (see audit report)
scenario_family tags noisy -- at least 4 confirmed mistagged records under tech_support (EXT-H-107..109, EXT-H-111)
13.3% (16/120) of HIGH records read as telemarketing/spam rather than social-engineering (see semantic_conflict_report.md)
45% of LOW and some HIGH/CAUTION records tagged scenario_family='other' (uninformative)

leakage_check.conclusion: No leakage detected against any SIH split, frozen or not. See leakage_report.json for full method.

provenance_policy.rule: source_type (and related provenance fields) must NEVER be passed to the classifier as an input feature. Retained only for experiment tracking, ablation, debugging, and reproducibility.

recommended_exclusion_set_for_experiment.criteria: Records matching telemarketing/spam-style patterns with no co-occurring social-engineering pattern, OR confirmed scenario_family mistagging documented in semantic_conflict_report.md
recommended_exclusion_set_for_experiment.note: This list comes from a narrow keyword heuristic plus 1 manually-confirmed mistag (EXT-H-111) -- treat as a starting point for human review, not a final, exhaustive determination. Remaining HIGH pool after exclusion: 103.

experiment_a_sih_only.purpose: Reproduce/extend the existing rule-baseline comparison point with a learned model trained on SIH data alone. Expected to be data-starved given train=7.

experiment_b_sih_plus_all_external.train: SIH train (7) + all 260 curated external records, MINUS zero records (no leakage exclusions needed)
experiment_b_sih_plus_all_external.validation: SIH validation split only (4 records) -- see validation-size caveat below
experiment_b_sih_plus_all_external.purpose: Test whether raw external volume improves generalization, accepting the known length-confound and spam-mislabel risks as-is.

experiment_c_sih_plus_filtered_external.train: SIH train (7) + curated external MINUS the 17-record exclusion set above (243 records)
experiment_c_sih_plus_filtered_external.purpose: Test whether curation quality (removing spam-like/mistagged records) matters more than raw volume -- the actual research question we care about.

proposed_experiment_configurations.shared_constraint: All three experiments evaluate on the EXACT SAME frozen SIH test/paraphrase_test/hard_negative_test/context_test/unseen_test/caution_test splits. source_type is retained in metadata for all training records but never exposed as a model input feature.

validation_size_caveat.issue: SIH validation split has only 4 records, all LOW, 3 scenario families -- insufficient alone for reliable model selection/early-stopping across three classes.
options_not_yet_decided: A. Use validation as-is and accept high-variance model-selection decisions (documented limitation, no contamination risk).

B. Carve out a SEPARATE validation-only slice from curated external data (e.g. stratified by class), clearly source-tagged, used ONLY for model selection -- never for final reported metrics, which still come solely from frozen SIH test sets.
C. Use k-fold cross-validation over SIH train+validation combined (11 records) for model selection, keeping frozen test sets untouched.
validation_size_caveat.recommendation: Leaning towards Option B (external-sourced validation-only slice) since it doesn't touch frozen SIH data and directly addresses the size problem, but this needs your sign-off before implementation since it changes what 'validation' means for this experiment.

grouping_for_near_duplicate_protection.issue: Some external records share template openings (e.g. 'this is the representative from the...', 59 occurrences) -- if such near-duplicate-structure records were split across train and validation, validation would leak train's surface patterns.
grouping_for_near_duplicate_protection.proposed_rule: Group external records by normalized opening-skeleton (first 6 words, alphanumeric-only) before any train/validation assignment; assign entire skeleton-groups to one side only. Not yet implemented -- proposed for review.

status: DESIGN ONLY -- no merged training file created. No model trained. Awaiting review before Phase 10 execution.
